name: @tn4consulting/shared-i18n
description: useLocale()/useTranslations() -- React hooks for cross-remote locale sync and {{param}}-interpolated UI-chrome translation, replacing the old provideMfeTransloco()/Transloco-based API. Every app repo converted to this major as of the family's completed React-only migration (2026-08); the last 0.x (Angular/Transloco-shaped) major stays published only as a historical artifact.
